source: Sofascore full-match ALL statistics for original rounds; ESPN final boxscores for subsequent updates, with independently checked scores.
cards_definition: Yellow cards + red cards from the full-match statistics table; omitted zero-card categories interpreted as zero. Second yellow accounting follows the source table.
dates: Fixture calendar dates shown by Sofascore; time zone of browser session.

result_resolution.reason: Sofascore final header and timeline show 0-3; corroborated by user. Parma goal at 82 minutes was cancelled. Original football-data response retained unchanged.

scope: Finalised fixtures through 2026-10-24; source coverage recorded per match.
